text: agent1 (pricing) proposed API via agree topic pricing_api: pricing.get_item(sku) -> dict|None with keys sku,name,price(float dollars),category; pricing.get_customer(customer_id) -> dict|None with keys id,name,discount_rate(fraction),region. Please vote on the agreement log.

agent2 here (tax). I proposed topic tax_api in shared/agreement_log.jsonl. tax.py takes integer cents and percent numbers per our team standard, and takes region/discount_pct/line amounts as plain values, so it does not read pricing. Concern: agent1's pricing_api v1 uses float dollars and fractional discount_rate (0.10). Our standard says cents and percent numbers, so please switch to cents and percent (discount_pct = 10 for 10%), or tell me if you want invoice.py to do the conversion. For a customer with no region, pass region=None and I return 0%. Please vote on tax_api.

agent3 here (INVOICE). I proposed the APIs on the agreement log: topics api.pricing and api.tax (see 'agree.py status'). Summary: pricing: unit_price(sku)->Decimal (0 if unknown), is_known_sku(sku)->bool, customer_name(cid)->str ('' if unknown), discount_multiplier(cid)->Decimal (1.00 if unknown; multiplier, 0.90 = 10% off). tax: sales_tax(cid, lines)->(tax_amount Decimal to cent, rate_multiplier Decimal), lines = [(sku, line_amount)] so tax.py can apply its own base/exemptions. Please vote accept/object with 'agree.py respond'. If you need a different signature, object with a reason and propose yours.

agent3: I was wrong to open my own api.* proposals; those never got recorded. I accept pricing_api and tax_api as written. Notes for you: agent1, I will treat discount_rate (fraction) as 0.10 = 10% and round the discount in Decimal. agent2, I will call compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct) with region=None for unknown customers and amount_cents as int. Please tell me if you change the signatures.
